pos.personaBrief: La Máquina's aim was possession with short passes (La Página Millonaria, Muñoz quote), though in 1965 he says the only truth is winning; the team kept the ball and outpassed opponents (Jensen).

pro.personaBrief: River played short passes starting from the defence and 'siete pases perfectos' (Juvenal, La Página Millonaria), and he says 'haga caminar la pelota'; but he prizes physique and sure players.

est.personaBrief: Fluid rotating forwards, Pedernera and Moreno dropping, 'fútbol loco' sessions without numbers or positions (Juvenal, 1965 interview); yet wingers kept to the touchline by his own order.

lar.personaBrief: He insisted on width: 'mande los punteros contra la raya', turned Loustau into a left winger, Muñoz into a right winger, two true wingers in the front five (1965 interview, Juvenal).

blo.personaBrief: No pressing facts are verified (gap); a W-M side that preferred to outpass opponents, with a stated taste for physique, aguante and sacrifice; I infer a fairly high line, not a deep block, from general knowledge.

mar.personaBrief: Only individual marking is verified: Yácono the sticky specialist man-marker (SI, El Gráfico, Jensen); a 1940s W-M implies man-oriented defending.

pla.personaBrief: No verified evidence on this axis; from general knowledge and his 1965 'I impose the principles' stance, he imposes his model but is pragmatic about results.

res.personaBrief: 1965 statedView: 'la única verdad es ganar... basta de lujos, basta de bordados'; pasecito and tejido were a degeneration.

sis.personaBrief: He let players find roles in free sessions (Pedernera at No. 9) yet says 'al jugador lo construyo yo' and demands sacrifice from all; talent given freedom inside a coach-imposed principle.

jog.personaBrief: Stated view 1965: 'primero hombres, después atletas', físico, aguante, velocidad; small players go to the wings; 'qué me importa el hábil' without other attributes, though La Máquina was technical.

bas.personaBrief: 1965: any player may play, a boy from the fourth division can reach the first team, all divisions share the same football; he backed the free young Loustau over a purchase; but winning is the aim.

lid.personaBrief: 1965: 'yo soy el que impongo los principios', whoever disagrees must leave; known for authority on all matters (Wikipedia); the coach is the boss.
